gujarati.description: The name of the book in Gujarati (e.g., આદર્શ ભક્ત ગાથા)

english.description: The name of the book in English or transliterated (e.g., Aadarsh Bhaktgatha)

book_page_no.description: The page sequence number derived from the file name (e.g., '84' for page_0084.md/json).

content_page_no.description: The page number as found in the text content (e.g., '84', '૮૫', '143', '૧૫૨'). Return an empty string if not found.

persons_mentioned.description: All person names mentioned on this page, including saints, devotees, historical figures, and deities.

places_mentioned.description: All place names mentioned on this page, including villages, cities, temples, regions, rivers, and mountains.

dates_mentioned.description: All dates mentioned on this page, in their original format as written in the text.

festivals_events_mentioned.description: All festivals, religious events, or ceremonies mentioned on this page.

text_content.description: Full page text, cleaned of page number markers ($$84$$, $૮૫$, etc.) and with extra whitespace normalized.
